heading.purpose: Conversation title, section titles, headline counts.

data.purpose: IDs, tool names and tool arguments only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: 160ms state transitions and the footnote arrival wash.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { background: var(--ink); color: var(--on-ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 4px; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as New conversation and Try again.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 4px; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--marked); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Starter Chip
components.html: <button class="ds-chip">What happens if I miss a payment?</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--marked); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Footnote Reference
components.description: Superscript link from a claim to its source entry.
components.css: .ds-fn { font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 650; line-height: 0; margin-left: 0.1em; } .ds-fn a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; padding: 0 0.15em; } .ds-fn a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

narrative.overview: One committed ink over cool paper, hairline rules instead of cards, three type sizes with tabular numerals, and a footnote on every claim.

rules.name: One state colour per meaning
rules.body: Green means allowed or verified; ochre means handed off, refused or short. No red.

rules.name: Three sizes
rules.body: 20, 15 and 13px only; rank by weight and case.

dos: Footnote every figure to its report file.
donts: No cards, shadows or stat tiles.
No HTML or Markdown rendering of model output.
